method: Same archived timeline, same original speed/deceleration/body bounds and static-world eligibility; added owned navigation cancellation/stop-intent coverage.

assessment.interpretation: PLANNING with a nonempty prior path and a fresh, clear front scan may move while replanning; this is not a full swept-path proof. Planner WAIT_REPLAN and owned navigation WAIT_CANCEL/WAIT_STOP permit bounded deceleration for 0.25 s and speed-dependent ground-truth travel based on the active Nav2 speed/deceleration profile. Navigation RECOVERING is logged separately. No instant command or inertial motion is automatically a failure. Only a known static Gazebo fixture can use the independent collision-geometry witness; it does not certify real-world or moving-obstacle safety.
